verdict.summary_en: Order confirmation OA26692691 from Guangzhou PackRight to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318781 (dated 2026-11-02). One line: item 00010, PR-RB-2207 Collector's Box Grand Heist 6, 25,500 pcs at 25.62 CNY, confirmed for 2027-01-04. Terms are FOB Yantian, NET30. A note says the lid magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 per box) are fitted by the supplier and included in the unit price.
red_flags: The supplier states the magnets RM-N42-D0401 (4 pcs per box) are fitted in its plant and included in the unit price. The buyer should check this against the PO and any separate magnet supply or pricing, to avoid double sourcing or double payment.
observations: Typed, single-page PDF with no handwriting, stamps, signatures or corrections.
The document has no printed issue date; the only date besides the confirmed delivery date is the PO date 2026-11-02.
The quantity column has no unit stated.
No line total or document total is given.
